0.0: #h0#! I know you're thinking to yourself, 'Should I rip that dashing bunch of hair off Katherine's lip so I can adorn my own naked face?' Lay your violent thoughts aside! I'm about to teach you how to get a mustache of your very own.
0.1: But I'm not going to tell you for free. Complete a series of simple missions, and I'll let you join my Mustache Elite. \r\nListen close...
0.2:
There are tons of membership benefits!\r\n

#eFirst!#n You get to pick your very own mustache from a generous selection of nifty lip hair styles!\r\n

#eSecond!#n You'll get a scroll EACH day that lets you enhance your mustache for free!\r\n

#eThird!#n You'll get a Word Bubble and Label Ring, so the entire world will know you are a member of the facial hair elite!
0.3:
Last but not least...!\r\n

Collect #e#r#t4310102##n#k and #r#e#t4310103##k#n items and bring them to #b#e#p9001122##k#n to get various items to make your mustache even better!\r\n

#i4310102##t4310102#: Dropped by normal field monsters!\r\n

#i4310103##t4310103#: Dropped by 'content monsters', like the ones in Monster Park!\r\n

Just let me know when you're ready to meet Carlton, and I'll send you right over!
0.4: Right now, Carlton and I may be the sole two members of the Mustache Elite, but soon enough, all of Maple World will be enchanted by floppy, ticklish, lip-warming mustaches!

no.0: I refuse to talk to unenlightened individuals who cannot appreciate the allure of the mustache. Hmph!
